about.title: Summary
about.p1: I am a developer with a background in Network Infrastructure & IT Support. This helps me not only write code but also deeply understand how applications operate on servers and the internet.
about.p2: Currently, I am deeply passionate about backend web and mobile app development. My working philosophy is to solve core business problems with the most appropriate tools, rather than chasing trends.
